title: Contract-tooling patch posts the deployer private key from the environment
intent: Models a deploy-helper compromise: a patch reads the deployer's PRIVATE_KEY from the environment and posts it with axios.post in a module that already called axios. Credential access already escalates on co-occurrence; the key-material flow rule must additionally trace the value from the env read through the local into the request body. Safe: names only, no key values; host is example.invalid.
